title: Final Waiver and Extension of the Project Period With Funding-Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965, as Amended, Title VI, Part B, Native Hawaiian Education
summary: Education Department — Rule — The Secretary waives the requirements in the Education Department General Administrative Regulations (EDGAR) that generally prohibit project period extensions involving the obligation of additional Federal funds. The final waiver and extension would allow 21 projects under Assistance Listing Number (ALN) 84.362A to receive funding for up to one additional 12-month period, not to exceed September 30, 2027.

title: Beautifying Transportation Infrastructure Council; Public Meeting
summary: Transportation Department,  — Notice — The Office of the Secretary of Transportation (OST) announces the next public meeting of the Beautifying Transportation Infrastructure Council (Council) on September 30, 2026. This notice announces the date, time, and location of the virtual meeting, which will be open to the public. The purpose of the Council is to advise the Secretary of Transportation on enhancing the aesthetic value of our Nation's transportation systems.

title: Amendment of Restricted Areas R-2505, R-2524, R-2508, and R-2515 in California
summary: Transportation Department, Federal Aviation Administration — Rule — This action amends multiple coordinates used to describe restricted areas R-2505, R-2524, R-2508, and R-2515 in California. title: Reduction in Force Appeals; Correction
summary: Personnel Management Office — Rule — The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) published a final rule in the Federal Register on August 3, 2026, concerning reduction in force appeals. title: Streamlining Probationary and Trial Period Appeals; Correction and Technical Amendment

This document also makes a technical amendment to OPM regulations to conform its appeal-rights reference to the final rule.

title: Improving Performance, Accountability and Responsiveness in the Civil Service, and Recruitment and Relocation Incentive Waivers; Correcting Amendments
summary: Personnel Management Office — Rule — The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) is correcting technical and conforming errors arising from two recent final rules: "Improving Performance, Accountability and Responsiveness in the Civil Service," published February 6, 2026 and effective March 9, 2026, and "Recruitment and Relocation Incentive Waivers," published December 15, 2025 and effective February 13, 2026. The corrections make no substantive change to the regulations.
